title: Land Appraisal

origin.title: Redacted Appraisal Report: Uniform Agricultural Appraisal Report (AgWare UAAR), 10,777.89-acre ranch, Powder River County, Montana
origin.clearance_note: A real agricultural appraisal that the appraisal firm itself publishes as a work sample: its Samples page (https://warrenlandinc.com/samples/) links 'Redacted Appraisal Report' to this PDF. Downloaded by script. The publisher had already replaced the owner, client, ranch name, property address, legal description, file number and every comparable sale's grantor and grantee with the visible placeholder ***REDACTED***, removing the text rather than covering it. The source is 74 pages; this folder keeps 5 of them, split out with PyMuPDF: source pages 6 (report summary), 40 and 41 (sales comparison grids, sales 1-10), 43 (income approach) and 44 (reconciliation and opinion of value). The dropped pages include the cover and transmittal letter, the signed certification, photographs, maps, deeds and the appraisers' resumes. On the kept pages no personal data survives beyond the publisher's placeholders: no name, signature, phone number or account number, no hidden or white text other than section headings, no annotations or form fields. Two further things were removed that do not render: the PDF metadata (which named one of the appraisers as author) and the original's shared image resources, which every page referenced but these five pages never draw; they held the report's photographs, maps and resume scans. The five kept pages render pixel-identical to the originals and their text is unchanged.

redactions.note: Redaction was done by the publisher before release; this build replaced no text. Originals are not known and not recorded.

replaced_by_publisher.what: owner/occupant, property address and property location
legal description section, township and range
file number in each page header
ranch name in the reconciliation narrative

removed_in_this_build.what: PDF document metadata including the author field
unused shared image resources (photos, maps, resume scans) not drawn on any kept page

notes: Features one column of the Sales Comparison Approach grid on page 2 (source page 40, report page 36 of 70): comparable Sale #1 (D155), when it sold, its size, its price, the net per-acre adjustment and the resulting adjusted price per acre. Read top to bottom it is the arithmetic of one comparable. The request named no feature page or fields; its notes suggested the reconciliation (source page 44) or the sales grid (40-41), and suggested the three approach values, the opinion of value and marketing time, total deeded acres and overall value per acre. The sales grid was chosen because the reconciliation page received no groundings at all: every value printed there also appears on the summary page and the extraction grounded to the summary instead. On the summary page the Cost Approach, Sales Comparison Approach, Opinion of Value and Total Deeded Acres ground correctly, but the Income Approach value grounds off (to a dash), and the marketing time (12 months) and overall value per acre ($482) come back synthesized with no ranges, as does the whole allocation block and the sales comparison summary box. No person is featured; every name on these pages was already ***REDACTED*** by the publisher.
